section.content: 本实用新型涉及集成电路技术领域，且公开了一种半导体集成电路。该半导体集成电路，包括基板，所述基板上固定连接有时序产生器，所述基板上且位于时序产生器的一侧电性连接有脉冲发生器，所述脉冲发生器的一端电性连接有第一二极管，所述第一二极管的另一端电性连接有充电器。本实用新型，通过脉冲发生器内输入的脉冲信号为高电平，场效应管导通，利用控制输入回路的电场效应来控制输出回路电流，第二电容从场效应管的源极、漏极和第一二极管放电，生成瞬态大电流，此时第二二极管保护第一二极管，防止电源的电压反接发生危险事故，该集成电路能设计简单，方便操作，当获取大电流时，实现了对电源的保护，具有实用性。

The utility model relates to an integrated circuit technical field just discloses a semiconductor integrated circuit. The semiconductor integrated circuit comprises a substrate, wherein a time sequence generator is fixedly connected to the substrate, a pulse generator is electrically connected to one side, located on the time sequence generator, of the substrate, one end of the pulse generator is electrically connected with a first diode, and the other end of the first diode is electrically connected with a charger. The utility model discloses, be the high level through the pulse signal of input in the pulse generator, field effect switches on, the electric field effect who utilizes control input return circuit controls output circuit current, second electric capacity discharges from field effect's source electrode, drain electrode and first diode, generate transient state heavy current, the first diode of second diode protection this moment, prevent that the voltage reversal of power from taking place dangerous accident, this integrated circuit can design simply, convenient operation, when acquireing the heavy current, realized the protection to the power, has the practicality.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an integrated circuit technical field specifically is a semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background

Semiconductor lasers, also known as semiconductor lasers, are semiconductor lasers that use semiconductor materials as the working substance. Semiconductor diode semiconductor lasers are the most practical and important type of semiconductor lasers. It has small volume and long service life, and can pump its working voltage and current by simple current injection mode to be compatible with integrated circuit, so it can be integrated with it. And may also be directly current modulated at frequencies up to GHz to obtain high speed modulated laser output. Because of these advantages, semiconductor diode semiconductor lasers have found wide applications in laser communication, optical storage, optical gyros, laser printing, ranging, and radar, among others. In the prior art, a semiconductor laser circuit is complex, the efficiency is low, a thyristor circuit is relatively simple, but the semiconductor laser circuit is easily limited by the speed of a switching circuit, and the protection effect on a power supply is poor when large current is obtained under low voltage. Therefore, we propose a semiconductor integrated circuit.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit to prior art's not enough, the utility model provides a possesses advantages such as protection power, the injury problem that produces the power when acquireing the heavy current at low-voltage at present of having solved.

The utility model provides a technical scheme that its technical problem adopted is: the utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit, includes the base plate, fixedly connected with time sequence generator on the base plate, on the base plate and be located one side electric connection of time sequence generator have pulse generator, pulse generator's one end electric connection has first diode, the other end electric connection of first diode has the charger, fixedly connected with switching device on the base plate, install the controller on the base plate.

Furthermore, a first capacitor is installed on the pulse generator, and a transmitting device is installed at one end of the first capacitor.

Further, the switching device is electrically connected with the first diode, and one end of the switching device is electrically connected with the charger.

Furthermore, a second capacitor is fixedly connected in the charger, and one end of the second capacitor is electrically connected with a power supply.

Furthermore, the switching device comprises a third capacitor and a field effect transistor, a drain electrode of the field effect transistor is fixedly connected with a first resistor, a source electrode of the field effect transistor is fixedly connected with a second resistor, two ends of the first diode are electrically connected with a second diode, one end of the second capacitor is electrically connected with a third resistor, and one end of the third resistor, far away from the second capacitor, is electrically connected with a third diode.

Furthermore, the other end of the first resistor is electrically connected with the first diode.

The utility model has the advantages that:

1. the semiconductor integrated circuit controls the work of the whole device through the controller by the combined arrangement of a substrate, a time sequence generator, a pulse generator, a first capacitor, a transmitting device, a first diode, a charger, a second capacitor, a power supply, a switching device, a second capacitor, a field effect tube, a first resistor, a second diode, a third resistor, a third diode and a controller, the device can work accurately, rapidly and orderly through the time sequence generator, when a pulse signal input in the pulse generator is high level, the field effect tube is conducted, the electric field effect of an input control loop is utilized to control the current of an output loop, the second capacitor is discharged from a source electrode, a drain electrode and the first diode of the field effect tube to generate transient large current, the second diode protects the first diode at the moment, and prevents the voltage of the power supply from being reversely connected to generate dangerous accidents, the first resistor serves as a current-limiting resistor of a drain electrode of the field effect transistor, the third resistor and the third diode provide protection for the work of the second capacitor, when an input pulse signal is at a low level, the power supply continues to charge the second capacitor, the integrated circuit can be designed simply, is convenient to operate, realizes the protection of the power supply when large current is obtained, and has practicability.

Description of reference numerals: 1. a substrate; 2. a timing generator; 3. a pulse generator; 301. a first capacitor; 302. a transmitting device; 4. a first diode; 5. a charger; 501. a second capacitor; 502. a power source; 6. a switching device; 601. a second capacitor; 602. a field effect transistor; 603. a first resistor; 604. a second resistor; 605. a second diode; 606. a third resistor; 607. a third diode; 7. and a controller.

Detailed Description

The technical solution in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-2, a semiconductor integrated circuit includes a substrate 1, a timing generator 2 fixedly connected to the substrate 1, the device can work accurately, rapidly and orderly through the timing generator 2, a pulse generator 3 electrically connected to one side of the timing generator 2 on the substrate 1, a first capacitor 301 installed on the pulse generator 3, a transmitter 302 installed on one end of the first capacitor 301, a first diode 4 electrically connected to one end of the pulse generator 3, a charger 5 electrically connected to the other end of the first diode 4, a second capacitor 501 fixedly connected to the charger 5, a power source 502 electrically connected to one end of the second capacitor 501, a switch 6 fixedly connected to the substrate 1, the switch 6 including a third capacitor 601 and a fet 602, a first resistor 603 fixedly connected to a drain of the fet 602, the other end of the first resistor 603 is electrically connected to the first diode 4, the source of the fet 602 is fixedly connected to the second resistor 604, the two ends of the first diode 4 are electrically connected to the second diode 605, one end of the second capacitor 501 is electrically connected to the third resistor 606, one end of the third resistor 606, which is far away from the second capacitor 501, is electrically connected to the third diode 607, the switch device 6 is electrically connected to the first diode 4, one end of the switch device 6 is electrically connected to the charger 5, the substrate 1 is provided with the controller 7, and the controller 7 controls the operation of the whole device.

When the device is used, the controller 7 controls the work of the whole device, the time sequence generator 2 enables the device to work accurately, quickly and orderly, when a pulse signal input in the pulse generator 3 is at a high level, the field effect transistor 602 is conducted, the electric field effect of the control input loop is used for controlling the current of the output loop, the second capacitor 501 discharges from the source electrode, the drain electrode and the first diode 4 of the field effect transistor 602 to generate a transient large current, the second diode 605 protects the first diode 4 at the moment, the voltage of the power supply 502 is prevented from being reversely connected to cause a dangerous accident, the first resistor 603 serves as a current limiting resistor of the drain electrode of the field effect transistor 602, and the third resistor 606 and the third diode 607 provide protection for the work of the second capacitor 501; when the input pulse signal is low, the power supply 502 continues to charge the second capacitor 501.
